Default Title - R 1,250.00 ZAR Quantity Add to Cart   Designed to take you from a bluesy sizzle right through to heavy hair metal, the Sathanas Distortion from Caline is an all-round distortion pedal to suit any player. With simple Drive, Level, and Tone controls the CP501S can be easily dialled in and features a smooth tone stack voiced to suit any amplifier it sits in front of. Used to boost an amp into distortion, this pedal is ideal for lead lines and solos, or with the Distortion control pushed and going into a clean platform, the Sathanas emulates a cranked 100W stack that could blow down walls!
